description:
The application's own window ('main'), and every command it may call.

This is the editor, the settings panel and the agent panel, so it holds the whole declared surface except the two commands that belong to a pet window alone (`desktop_pet_close_own`, `desktop_pet_set_click_through` — see `capabilities/desktop-pet.json`). Deliberately the whole of it: the boundary this file draws is the pet's, and a main window refused a command the app actually uses would be a regression dressed as a security fix. The commands are declared in `build.rs`'s app manifest; an `allow-` name that is not declared there fails the build rather than granting nothing. One of the commands it hands out is worth naming: `agent_recover_change` puts a change an agent made back, and it is the only command on this surface that writes a vault file without a tab being involved. It belongs to `main` and to no other window for two reasons — the review that offers it is drawn in the editor pane's column, and the pet window, which is the only other window in this app, holds none of the `agent_*` surface and has no vault of its own. The write itself is not this file's to bound: it goes through `VaultFiles`, so the path is confined to the root of the session the caller named, and a renderer cannot name a folder it did not open.
